analysis_md:
方程化为 $(-x^2+y^2)\,dx-2xy\,dy=0,$

$$
P(x,y)=-x^2+y^2,\quad Q(x,y)=-2xy,
$$

$$
\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=4y,
$$

$$
\frac{1}{Q}\left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}\right)=-\frac{2}{x},
$$

故积分因子为 $\mu(x)=e^{-\int\frac{2}{x}\,dx}=x^{-2},$
